description: Figure 8b illustrates the performance on Llama2. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10<sup>1</sup> to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 10<sup>1</sup> and 10<sup>2</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Five lines are plotted: a green line with triangle markers representing “Base”, a red line with circle markers representing “MEND”, a blue line with square markers representing “FT”, a purple line with diamond markers representing “MEMIT”, and an orange line with x markers representing “ROME”.  The “Base” line starts at approximately 68% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and increases to approximately 76% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The “MEND” line begins at approximately 70% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and rises to approximately 78% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The “FT” line starts at approximately 65% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and increases to approximately 75% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The “MEMIT” line begins at approximately 72% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and rises to approximately 79% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The “ROME” line starts at approximately 75% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and increases to approximately 80% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. All lines are solid.
